veranderings.blok: Toe onthou nie meer genoeg was nie
veranderings.voor: hoeveel graan in die skuur is
veranderings.na: hoeveel graan daar in die skuur is
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans normally uses existential 'daar' in a clause stating how much of something is somewhere; without it the clause reads stiff.

veranderings.na: voor, en ander stel 'n klank voor
veranderings.rede: The elided verb makes the second half hard for a Grade 4 reader to parse; repeating it gives two full clauses, which then take the AWS comma before 'en'.
